content.short: Papaya builds stablecoin payment products, including recurring payments and US-Vietnam transfers.
content.description: Papaya builds products for moving money on stablecoin rails, including recurring and subscription stablecoin payments and simple cross-border business payments between the US and Vietnam. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Papaya.
content.meta: Papaya builds stablecoin subscription and cross-border payment products, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
